actions.query: card through ask, with explicit key and records; observation only
actions.plan: Root record coverage before consent, and fresh native coverage before signing
actions.land: Root signed-record admission before native land; native land independently verifies the actual act

snapshot: A change to the Root epoch invalidates old cards globally. An unrelated key can retain its eligibility while its old card becomes stale. The original Root anchor is not revoked by a local keys/root coverage declaration.
clock: The receiver supplies time. An instant card is not a future grant; replay at another instant can refuse authority-card/clock. Neither caller fields nor a presented card choose the receiver context.

Q4.existingChecks: Retain the existing domain card, permission, secret and consent checks. Native authority observations do not replace them.

security: No authority installed by receiving a card
A policy change during consent cannot land a cached lot on the old base
Code boundaries do not provide OS isolation from a compromised process of the same user
evidence: Regional source vectors in two unrelated places and Node 22/24; not installed release acceptance, CI or independent-machine evidence
epochSelection: Bound selects and authenticates the receiver local admission epoch through its public native API. Foreign evidence epochs never select receiver authority; presented cards are still revalidated by Bound.
